Title: Admission Cycles as a real hard-prerequisite scoping dimension
Notes: (programmeId, academicYearId, cycleId) is now the composite identity for candidates — a candidate can legitimately exist in more than one cycle of the same programme+year (re-applying in a later round). Real ds.admissionCycles collection (was decorative localStorage) + header Cycle selector (always visible, 3rd dropdown) + CYCLE_GATED_PAGES hard-blocks Import/Candidate List/Profile until a cycle exists for the active programme+year. cycleId threaded through commitImportJob's candidate stamping + existing-candidate dedup. Per explicit decision: existing data is NOT auto-migrated — old files show the gate until a fresh cycle is created; scope also covers Sessions/Groups/Zoom Rooms/Panelist Allocation per product decision but that threading is NOT done yet (tracked separately). Bugs found and fixed along the way: a lucide.js icon conditionally toggled by React crashed the reconciler (removeChild on a node lucide had already replaced with raw DOM — see the Selected/Select badge markup, no more data-lucide icons there); createAdmissionCycle's Date.now()-based id collided when two cycles were created in the same millisecond, switched to a sequential counter; Activate/Close button visibility used inverted-inequality checks instead of exact status match. Verified: 84/84 e2e (func-admission-cycles.spec.js rewritten for the real model, admission-workflow.spec.js gains a cycle-creation step) + admission-engine.test.mjs (2 new unit tests).
